offering_description.value: Distributes industrial maintenance supplies, test and measurement equipment, and outsourced supply chain services to manufacturers, contractors and OEMs. Sells mainly through field sales, catalogs and online channels, with some on-site inventory programs.

primary_products.value: MRO supplies; test and measurement equipment; electronic components; fasteners; safety products

primary_services.value: supply chain management; vendor-managed inventory; repair and calibration; kitting and assembly

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, contractors, maintenance teams, OEMs, electronics engineers and technicians

end_markets.value: manufacturing; aerospace; electronics; automotive; industrial maintenance

revenue_model.value: product sales: MRO supplies and test equipment sold to business customers; service fees: repair, calibration and kitting services; project or contract: multi-year outsourced supply chain management contracts
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys from manufacturers and sells MRO and test products to industrial customers; service provider: runs outsourced inventory and repair work for OEMs and manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, Mexico, Europe and Asia, mainly through Gexpro Services

specialization.value: diversified: Lawson MRO supplies, TestEquity test equipment, Gexpro Services outsourced supply chain

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field sales reps serving industrial accounts; online: e-commerce sites and print and digital catalogs; own locations: distribution centers and on-site supply rooms at customer plants

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only general commercial and product safety rules apply
